decision_conditions: The facing materials used in the development to which this permission relates shall match those of the existing building(s) unless otherwise agreed in writing by the local planning authority.Reason: To ensure a satisfactory appearance on completion of the development, in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policies CS8 and DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.

The development has been assessed against the provisions of Class AA of Schedule 2, Part 1 of the Town and Country Planning General Permitted Development (England) Order 2015 (as amended) and found to comply with the required provisions.

The development hereby permitted shall begin before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: To accord with the provisions of Article 3, Schedule 2, Part 1, Class AA of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development Order) (England) 2015 (As Amended).

Following the development, the dwellinghouse must be used as a dwellinghouse within the meaning of Class C3 of the Schedule to the Use Classes Order and for no other purpose, except to the extent that the other purpose is ancillary to the primary use as a dwellinghouse.Reason: To ensure that the development would not have an unacceptable impact on the amenity of the existing building and neighbouring premises and the local transport network in accordance with policy D3 of the London Plan 2021 and policy DM10 of the LDF Core Strategy 2012.
application_type_full: Householder: Enlargement of a dwellinghouse by construction of additional storeys
description: Erection of an additional storey to an existing detached dwellinghouse  with maximum height of 10760mm under Schedule 2, Part 1, Class AA of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) with determination date 25/02/2026.
